summary: Wave 34 — Journey Builder (Kanban stage-lanes) + LeadStatus catalog + gates/allow-list independently verified end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_journey_builder.py with 10 pytest cases, all PASS (catalog 5 stages/45 statuses, gates on S2_MEETING_SCHEDULED, disallowed jump 422, first-move stamps SLA, gate-block 422 with missing budget_min+timeline, saved workflow graph carries BOTH journey lanes AND drawflow, simulate walks trigger→whatsapp→task→status_change with catalog codes, /leads /leads/board /dashboard regression 200). Frontend (headless Chromium at preview URL): logged in as admin@crm.local, navigated #/workflows, verified 5 lanes (jb-lane-S1..S5) with SLA badges '2H FIRST CONTACT / 24H / 48H / 24H / ONGOING', explainer banner, jb-save + jb-reset. Seeded Agrocorp journey present per lane (S1 has WhatsApp Lead Acknowledgement + First contact task + Change Status→Assigned with 'Duplicate→review' & 'Invalid→close' chips; S2 has qualify task, If-branch with 3 chips, Meeting Scheduled; S3 has Appointment Confirmation WhatsApp + Visit Reminder + Wait 1 day + Cost Sheet email + status changes; S4 ends with Converted to Customer; S5 has agreement/payment steps). '+ Add step' opens palette (jb-palette) with all 6 options (send_whatsapp/send_email/wait/task/status_change/condition). Choosing status_change opens drawer (jb-drawer) with jb-drawer-status <select> grouped by 5 <optgroup>s labelled 'S1 · Lead Entry' … 'S5 · Customer Lifecycle' totalling 46 options (45 catalog + placeholder). Editing an S3 WhatsApp card via jb-f-template persisted after Save. jb-save shows toast 'Journey saved & active — it now drives every new lead'. Reload preserves saved journey (not default). Regression: /#/leads renders table, /#/dashboard loads. Cleaned up by clicking Reset → Save so lanes are back to 3/5/8/5/5 default cards.

issues: SLA badge on non-S3 lanes reads in short form '2H', '24H', 'ONGOING' etc without a 'SLA' label prefix — S3 shows '48H'. Not broken; just inconsistent spelling with the guideline 'each lane with an SLA badge'. Consider prefixing 'SLA · 48h' for clarity.
Admin still lands on #/onboarding after login even though setup is 5/5 complete (pre-existing from wave 33, not a Wave 34 regression). Had to force #/workflows via URL. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix admin post-login redirect (5/5 onboarding complete but router still sends admin to #/onboarding).
OPTIONAL: Prefix all lane SLA badges consistently (e.g. 'SLA · 2h' / 'SLA · 48h') — currently mixed short forms.
critical_code_review_comments: JourneyController::statuses correctly groups statuses by stage_key with allowed_next + gate_fields + sla_minutes exposed to the client — clean, no ObjectId/leakage issues.

JourneyController::transition delegates to FlowEngine::applyStatus which enforces allow-list, gates and SLA stamping — verified: first move OK, disallowed → 422 with 'Allowed next: …' message, gate → 422 with {gate:[missing fields]}.

Saved workflow graph contains both a 'journey' view-model (5 lanes) AND a compiled 'drawflow' graph — enables the FlowEngine to run per lead while the builder re-hydrates lanes on reload. Verified via GET /workflows/{id}.
Simulate log shows status_change entries reference catalog codes ('Set status → S1_ASSIGNED', 'S2_QUALIFYING', 'S2_MEETING_SCHEDULED') — engine successfully resolves palette output to catalog codes.
UI palette contains exactly the 6 documented step types with correct data-testid; drawer status <select> is grouped by <optgroup> — good for accessibility & tests.
Toast + reload persistence path works end-to-end (POST /workflows or PUT /workflows/{id}, then reload GET rehydrates lanes).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (lanes, seeded journey content, add step palette, edit drawer with grouped status dropdown, save toast, reload persistence, regression pages)
